picks.title: STRATEGY SPOTLIGHT: Tools - SymphonyOS V2
picks.rationale: SymphonyOS V2 rebuilds its marketing suite around six specialised AI agents covering artist and label rollouts. It is a fresh product release (Sep 25) that artist teams can try now.
picks.excerpt: SymphonyOS has launched SymphonyOS V2, its biggest update since launch. Billing itself as "the agent company of music", the platform has rebuilt its marketing suite around six specialised AI agents, each dedicated to a different part of an artist's career or a label's rollout.

picks.title: Resolume 7.28 uses vision to let you play with intelligent live effects and blends
picks.rationale: Resolume 7.28 adds local computer-vision Wire nodes, effects and blends for segmentation and background removal. It is a concrete AI feature for live AV and VJ performers, and a different angle from the audio tools.
picks.excerpt: Take a break from the surveillance nightmare around us for computer vision that's local, not online, and doing creative, artistic things, instead. picks.title: Minimal Instruments Nagi Offers A No-Code Route To Building Native Audio Plugins
picks.rationale: Nagi pairs a node editor and Faust DSP with a local AI assistant that generates DSP code or GUI layouts from plain-language requests. It is a hands-on tool for building plugins without code, and a different product from the Amorph story published on 09-24.
picks.excerpt: Nagi combines a visual node editor, Faust DSP code and an interface designer, with a local AI assistant that generates Faust DSP or GUI layouts from natural-language requests.

picks.title: Spotify Extends Launch of 'Taste Profile' Algorithm Tweaks
picks.rationale: Spotify's AI Taste Profile reaches the US, so listeners can steer recommendations in natural language. This changes how music gets discovered, and it is a separate story from the Meta Muse connector, which was left out.
picks.excerpt: Spotify's AI-powered Taste Profile expands to the US, letting listeners tweak recommendations with natural-language requests, even by describing a 'vibe'.

picks.title: LANDR expands AI fraud detection built with machine learning lab Mila
picks.rationale: LANDR expands its ML fraud detection, built with Mila, and reports a 95% drop in Spotify-flagged artificial streams. This is a measured result for AI-driven distribution integrity, and a separate story from the earlier LANDR Fair Trade AI coverage.
picks.excerpt: Distribution and music creation platform expands streaming fraud detection system…
